title: picea abies var. obovata
intro: Picea abies var. obovata, commonly known as Siberian spruce, is a variety of the white spruce tree native to Russia and parts of Europe. It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, soothe irritated tissues, and provide antioxidant protection. The bioactive constituents of Siberian spruce include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
